title: Lane Ends: Merge Early and Deliberately
section: Section 6 · End of Lane Markings; Changing Lanes
intro: The blue car is in the next lane. There is space behind it.
watchCaption: Your lane ends. There is room behind the blue car.
safeCaption: Signal. Mirrors. Shoulder check. Merge into the gap.
unsafeCaption: Moving over now would cut off the blue car.
safeFeedback: You signal, check the blind spot, and merge into the open space behind blue.

feedback.force-at-end: You reached the narrowing lane beside blue. Match its speed and use the space behind it.
feedback.cross-barrier: The double solid white lines separate lanes you cannot cross here. Use the open lane beside you.
